subject: Money
title: Peer Pressure on Kids
description: A fast breakdown of Peer Pressure on Kids for builders.

hook.text: Kids recognize brand logos by age 3. By age 10, they influence $500 billion in family spending yearly.

buildup.text: Children learn spending from peers, not parents. The desire for the right sneakers starts in kindergarten.

discovery.text: Marketers target children because brand loyalty formed young lasts decades. A child customer is a lifetime customer.

twist.text: Sweden banned ads aimed at children under 12. The US has no such law. Markets shape culture.

climax.text: Children learn that buying equals belonging before they learn what money actually is.

punchline.text: Brand loyalty starts before reading does.

quiz.question: At what age do children recognize brand logos?
